Module: 0. Set-up: Events the other cases use
Test Case Title: A single-stage RFQ that is live with Vendors An and B invited and no bid yet
Pre-conditions: Vendors A, B and C are the QA test vendors of the test company (their names start with "QA_Platform" and their e-mails end with @example.com). Never invite a real supplier.
Configs Needed:
rfx_project_enabled = On — turns on eRFX projects
lock_vendors_addition_in_event_creation = Off — vendors can be added while creating (with it On, Publish is greyed out)
Test Data: Product CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB, quantity 10, location Plant Name (LOC-0001).
Test Steps:
1. Log in to Procol (buyer side) with the buyer user
2. From the left menu click "Events". The events list opens with the tabs Live, History, Drafts and Recurring
3. Click the blue "Create Event" button at the top right
4. In the pop-up click "Single Stage" (Source through RFP / RFQ / Auction). The create screen opens with Event Type set to "RFP"
5. Under Event Type click "RFQ"
6. Move the mouse over "Select Templates" and click the RFQ template in the menu that opens. The product sheet appears (Product, Product Variant, Quantity Requested, Delivery location, Price)
7. Click the first "Product" cell, type "CYLINDER" and click CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB in the list. "Product Variant" fills itself with "Default Variant"
8. Click "Quantity Requested", type 10 and press Tab. Click "Delivery location" and pick Plant Name (LOC-0001)
9. Click "Search vendors you want to add" under Participants, type the name of Vendor A and Vendor B and click each under "VENDORS" in the list
10. Give the title "QA_Platform Live RFQ"
11. Click the schedule chip in the footer, keep "Start now", pick "24 Hrs" under Duration and click "Save Schedule"
12. Click "Publish Event" (single stage) or "Publish" (eRFX) in the footer and confirm the pop-up
Expected Result: The project page opens with a green "Live" badge and a countdown. Later test cases call this "the live RFQ (no bids)".

Pre-conditions: Vendors A, B and C are the QA test vendors of the test company (their names start with "QA_Platform" and their e-mails end with @example.com). Never invite a real supplier.

allow_draft_project_creation = On — enables saving eRFX as draft

9. Add the two clauses and tick "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" (each clause then shows "Overridden by Mark all mandatory")
10. Click "Done"
11. Click "Search vendors you want to add" under Participants, type the name of Vendor A and click it under "VENDORS" in the list
12. Click the schedule chip in the footer (it reads "Now - <time> ( 30 Mins )"). In the "Schedule Event" drawer keep "Start now", keep "Duration" 30 Mins and click "Save Schedule"
13. Click "Publish Event" (single stage) or "Publish" (eRFX) in the footer and confirm the pop-up
14. Log in to the Procol vendor portal with Vendor A's user (use a second browser or an incognito window so the buyer stays logged in)

16. The vendor accepts one of the two clauses, quotes 100 for every line (or answers the questionnaire) and clicks Submit

Pre-conditions: An existing event: the old version of a project that has a newer version. If none exists, make one first with the create cases (modules 3–9) and module 0.
Configs Needed:
hide_withdraw_in_intake_and_event = Off — shows the Withdraw option on events
is_event_versioning_enabled = On — amendments create new versions
rfx_project_enabled = On — turns on eRFX projects
Test Steps:
1. Log in to Procol (buyer side) with the buyer user
2. From the left menu click "Events". The events list opens with the tabs Live, History, Drafts and Recurring
3. Find the old version of a project that has a newer version: type its title in "Search Title" and click it in the list. The project page opens
4. On the stage page click "Settings" (gear icon) at the top right of the stage. The settings menu opens
Expected Result: "Withdraw" is disabled on old versions; only the latest version can be withdrawn.

Module: 30. End-to-end — PR to PO, every main combination
Test Case Title: Material PR → single stage RFQ → complete award to L1 → PO
User Role: Buyer, Vendor A, Vendor B, Approver
Pre-conditions: Vendors A, B and C are the QA test vendors of the test company (their names start with "QA_Platform" and their e-mails end with @example.com). Never invite a real supplier.
Configs Needed:
rfx_project_enabled = On — turns on eRFX projects
lock_vendors_addition_in_event_creation = Off — vendors can be added while creating (with it On, Publish is greyed out)
Test Steps:
1. Log in to Procol (buyer side) with the buyer user
2. From the left menu click "Purchase Requisitions". The PR list opens on the "Open" tab
3. Tick an open material PR line (10 ST)
4. Purchase Items > Start New Project > Single Stage > RFQ > RFQ template
5. Scroll to "Participants". A strip says "Invite N more participant based on the products". Click its "Invite Vendor" button: every vendor mapped to the product is added (or search Vendors A and B by name if the test names them)
6. Schedule: Duration 30 Mins, evaluation 30 Mins; Save Schedule
7. Add one Required T&C clause
8. Click "Publish Event" (single stage) or "Publish" (eRFX) in the footer and confirm the pop-up
9. Log in to the Procol vendor portal with Vendor A's user (use a second browser or an incognito window so the buyer stays logged in)
10. Accept the T&C, quote 100 (per activity for a service), submit
11. Log in to the Procol vendor portal with Vendor B's user (use a second browser or an incognito window so the buyer stays logged in)
12. Accept the T&C, quote 90, submit
13. Log in to Procol (buyer side) with the buyer user
14. When bidding ends, open Master QCS and check B is rank 1
15. Start Awarding: Award all to the lowest vendor (B)
16. Create Proposal, Submit Proposal; approve it with a remark as the approver
17. Open Purchase Orders, the Events History tab and the PR
Expected Result: Every step works in order. The PR line goes Open → In Progress → ordered. The event goes Live → (evaluation) → History. Master QCS ranks B first. Award result: Vendor B gets the whole quantity at its own price, with one PO.

Scenario: Direct event → single stage RFQ without a PR
Test Case Title: Event made directly (single stage RFQ without a PR) → complete award to L1 → PO
User Role: Buyer, Vendor A, Vendor B, Approver
Pre-conditions: The buyer can create events on the test company; QA test vendors exist (names start with QA_Platform).
Configs Needed:
rfx_project_enabled = On — turns on eRFX projects
lock_vendors_addition_in_event_creation = Off — vendors can be added while creating (with it On, Publish is greyed out)
Test Steps:
1. Log in to Procol (buyer side) with the buyer user
2. From the left menu click "Events". The events list opens with the tabs Live, History, Drafts and Recurring
3. Click the blue "Create Event" button at the top right
4. In the pop-up click "Single Stage" (Source through RFP / RFQ / Auction). The create screen opens with Event Type set to "RFP"
5. Under Event Type click "RFQ"
6. Move the mouse over "Select Templates" and click the RFQ template in the menu that opens. The product sheet appears (Product, Product Variant, Quantity Requested, Delivery location, Price)

Test Case Title: Extend a live RFQ by the first ready slot
Pre-conditions: Set-up case SRC-SET-001 done ("the live RFQ (no bids)").

7. Choose the first ready slot
8. Click "Ok"
Expected Result: The window closes and the app says "Order time updated". Then the countdown in the header and the event's end time move: the new end is E + that slot's duration (check the end time shown on the stage page and in the event list); the vendor portal shows the same new end; vendors can still bid until it.
